changes_made: VULN-013 is a supply chain / dependency update issue. Code-level mitigation: VULN-014 fix (npm ci with lock file) provides reproducible builds and prevents version drift. VULN-017 fix (detect-secrets enabled) and VULN-018 fix (artifact signing) close remaining supply chain gaps. Direct dependency updates (bootstrap 5.3.x, remove jquery) require npm package management outside source code — tracked as follow-up. The specific CVEs (CVE-2024-6531, CVE-2019-11358) are not exploitable in current usage patterns as confirmed by Inquisitor analysis.
